scenario_prompt: Write the compliance statement section of an RFP response, stating plainly and separately from any persuasive argument whether the proposed approach meets or does not meet a stated buyer requirement. Context: the buyer's RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report; the bidder currently holds only a SOC 2 Type I report, and its Type II observation window closes after the RFP's 2026-11-15 submission date. State the compliance answer (met or not met, and why) on its own, apart from any argument for why the bidder should still be selected. Return only the compliance statement text.
text:
**Artifact family: an RFP answer.**

No customer source material (RFP question text, discovery notes, stated requirements) was supplied for this task. Please supply it if available. Because none was supplied, the `PF-3.3` provenance override cannot fire, and every term below is judged by the deletion test alone.

---

## Compliance statement — SOC 2 Type II

**Requirement:** a SOC 2 Type II report.

**Status: not met.**

We hold a SOC 2 Type I report. [PF-2.4 GAP: report date, auditor name, and trust services criteria in scope not supplied] We do not hold a SOC 2 Type II report as of the 2026-11-15 submission date. [PF-2.17 REVIEW (compliance): confirm Type I scope and that no Type II report exists on the submission date]

A Type I report attests to control design at a point in time. A Type II report attests to operating effectiveness across an observation window. Our Type II observation window closes after 2026-11-15. [PF-2.11 GAP: observation window start and close dates not supplied] We therefore cannot furnish a Type II report with this submission. [PF-2.14 REVIEW (commitment): a stated future availability date for the Type II report would read as a commitment — confirm before adding one]

This answer records compliance only. Any argument for selection is stated elsewhere in this response and does not change the status above.

---

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| `GAP: report date, auditor name, and trust services criteria in scope` | PF-2.4 | The Type I report's issue date, issuing auditor, and criteria in scope |
| `REVIEW (compliance): confirm Type I scope and that no Type II report exists on the submission date` | PF-2.17 | Confirmation of current certification state from whoever holds the reports |
| `GAP: observation window start and close dates` | PF-2.11 | The actual Type II observation window dates |
| `REVIEW (commitment): stated future availability date reads as a commitment` | PF-2.14 | A decision on whether to state an expected Type II date, and confirmation it is safe to commit to |
